description: Everything EveryAI lists about one AI tool: description, features, category and use case, pricing as its listing states it, platforms it mentions, a 0-100 data-quality score (completeness, link health, freshness), last-verified date and links. Call this when the user names a specific tool and wants its details, or before repeating a claim about a tool from recommend_tool or search_tools. If the name is not an exact match you get suggestions instead.

tool.description: A tool's slug ("acme-notes-jd7abc12"), EveryAI page URL, website ("https://acme.ai") or exact name ("Acme Notes").

name: get_tool
title: Get one AI tool's details
